description: CRA simplified-method rates (latest published tax year): flat meal rate per meal and maximum per day, and vehicle cents/km by province or territory where travel begins. These apply to moving expenses, northern residents deductions and medical travel, not to employer per-diems. Optionally calculates amounts. Returns structuredContent with the tax year, meal rates, vehicle cents/km (one province or all), optional vehicle and meal amounts, scope notes, the source and an as-of date.

days.description: Number of days (caps meals at the daily maximum).

kilometres.description: Kilometres driven, to calculate a vehicle amount (needs province).

province.description: Province or territory where the travel begins.

name: cra_meal_travel_allowance

asOf.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the figures were last checked against the source pages

dataVersion.description: Version of the Tallyfern Rates dataset, e.g. 2026.10.03

latestPublishedNote.description: Which tax year the CRA page showed as of the check date

mealAmount.description: Meal amount (when meals or days were given)

amount.description: Meal amount after applying the daily maximum, in CAD

rule.description: The rule applied, e.g. '$23 per meal, up to $69 per day per person.'

currencyNote.description: CRA notes on currency, sales tax and receipts

region.description: Province or territory where travel begins, if given

relatedLink.description: Related free Tallyfern tool or page

scope.description: What these rates apply to (moving expenses, northern residents deductions, medical travel) and what they don't

pageDateModified.description: 'Date modified' shown on the page, if any

taxYear.description: Tax year of the simplified rates returned (latest published on the CRA page)

vehicleAmount.description: Kilometres × cents per km, converted to CAD dollars (when kilometres and province were given)

vehicleCentsPerKm.description: Cents per km for the province where travel begins

vehicleCentsPerKmByProvince.description: Cents per km by province code (when no province was given)

title: CRA simplified meal and vehicle rates
